Biological Sciences [BSCI] with lab
To meet College of Arts and Sciences requirements, students must complete 1 additional lab credit of [BSCI] or [PSCI] for a total of 8 credits (2 labs).

Equity and Justice [EQJS]

HISTORY Electives
History Electives – 30 credits required, minimum 15 credits at 300 - 400 level; must include 6 hours U.S. history (HISTORY 110, 111, 201, 216, 224, 235, 250, 280, 298, 308, 311, 312, 313, 314, 316, 318, 319, 324, 328, 360, 361, 320, 321, 322, 390, 398, 409, 410, 415, 417, 423, or 486), 6 hours European history (HISTORY 101, 102, 340, 341, 342, 343, 344, 345, 347, 349, 350, 354, 356, 359, 367, 368, 386, 391, 444, 462, or 463) and 9 hours Non-Western/Global history (HISTORY 120, 121, 230, 270, 271, 272, 273, 275, 291, 325, 330, 331, 332, 333, 334, 335, 337, 339, 366, 371, 372, 373, 374, 377, 387, 388, 435, 436, 474, 475, 476, 483, 492, or 495).

Physical Sciences [PSCI] with lab
To meet College of Arts and Sciences requirements, students must complete 1 additional lab credit of [BSCI] or [PSCI] for a total of 8 credits (2 labs).

Foreign Language, if needed, or Elective

Complete Writing Portfolio

HISTORY 300 [M]

Electives
Electives should include sufficient 300-400-level courses to meet University requirement of 40 credits of upper division coursework.

HISTORY 469 [M]

Integrative Capstone [CAPS]

Complete History Department’s Exit Survey

36 credits of history are required, including 6 credits of US history, 6 credits of European history, and 9 credits of Non-Western/Global history; 21 credits at the 300-400-level, which must include HISTORY 300 and 469. 

To be admitted to the History – General option, a student must make their intention known to the department and have earned at least a 2.0 cumulative GPA.

It is assumed that prior to the junior year the student will have completed courses meeting UCORE and College of Arts and Sciences requirements for graduation.

To graduate, a grade of C or better is required in all history courses used to fulfill the requirements for this degree.
